profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer / Subject Matter Expert (SME)
profile.summary:
Current development stack: Java, Spring, REST, AWS, Aurora, DynamoDB
Historical development stack: C#, C++, ATL, STL, OOD, OOP, COM

positions.title: Software Engineer / Subject Matter Expert (SME)
positions.description:
Driven the architectural evolution of enterprise healthcare claims processing systems across three decades, scaled from legacy distributed desktop components to high-throughput, compliant cloud-native microservices.
Cloud & Modernization Era (Java 21 / Java 25 & AWS)
· Led Application Modernization Initiatives: Spearheaded consecutive major language upgrades from Java 8 to Java 11, 17, 21, and 25; modernized third-generation batch-processing systems, eliminated repository vulnerabilities, and migrated core runtimes from Amazon Corretto to OpenJDK.
· Architected Cloud-Native Infrastructure: Designed and deployed highly available serverless APIs and microservices using AWS Lambda, ECS, DynamoDB, and Aurora to process enterprise-scale healthcare claims.
· Engineered Centralized Data Pipelines: Created an automated logging and analytical framework utilizing AWS Kinesis Firehose, Lambda, S3, and Glue to aggregate distributed CloudWatch logs into an AWS Athena data catalog, drastically reducing cross-team debugging cycles.
· Developed API Test Automation: Built a zero-code API Automation Test framework featuring response validation and intelligent timeout directives, enabling rapid consumer validation without requiring additional deployments or unit tests.
· Technical Leadership & Domain Expertise: Served as global Subject Matter Expert (SME) to onboard and mentor distributed engineering teams on complex healthcare claims processing logic and cloud infrastructure best practices.
Distributed Systems & FISMA Compliance Era (Java & Spring Boot)
· Architected Secure Frameworks: Designed and built a second-generation, FISMA-compliant batch processing system processing millions of daily healthcare claims.
· Built High-Throughput Backend Subsystems: Developed robust ETL data pipelines featuring inner-process communication via ActiveMQ, data normalization, schema validation, complex group ruling logic, and print-order optimization.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.locationName: Kansas City, Missouri, United States · On-site
positions.description:
· Advanced Real-Time Train Visualization: Evaluated, selected, and integrated a computer-aided design (CAD) ActiveX control into the Train Information System (TIS) to map and display live train locations using Visual C++, MFC, and Object-Oriented methodologies.
  
· Engineered Dynamic Operator Alerting: Developed animated graphical views to provide real-time visual warnings to operators during critical alert conditions, automatically identifying and pinning the exact incident locations directly on the active CAD interface.
  
· Integrated Web-Based Reporting Subsystems: Researched and deployed Crystal Reports to extract, process, and present relational data from an Oracle database, delivering automated system reports to end-users via the web.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Programmer
positions.description:
· Engineered Mission-Critical Flight Software: Designed and developed core enhancements for the Operational Flight Program (OFP) guiding the F/A-18 Super Hornet (E and F variants) utilizing C++, VxWorks RTOS, and Object-Oriented methodologies.
· Led Avionics Diagnostics & Self-Testing: Served as the primary point of contact for the architecture and development of Built-In-Test (BIT) procedures, enabling real-time self-diagnosis of irregular flight operations and hardware failures.
· Developed Low-Level Hardware Interfaces: Engineered robust software interfaces for Non-Volatile Random-Access Memory (NVRAM), General Purpose Processors (GPP), and distributed remote hardware components interacting with the Advanced Mission Computer (AMC).
· Managed Fault Logging & Error Services: Acted as technical lead for the OFP Error Service subsystem, capturing and logging critical runtime anomalies during both evaluation testing and active flight operations.
· Built Diagnostic Archival Tooling: Created a dedicated desktop error-tracking application using Visual C++, MFC, and OLEDB to archive, analyze, and streamline the troubleshooting of complex runtime system errors.

company.name: Department of Defense, Scott Air Force Base
